outcome.description: done when you finished the work; needs_input when the issue cannot be implemented without answers from a person.

pullRequest.description: The text Foundry publishes your work with: the pull request it opens, or a summary comment on the existing one. Foundry lays it out and links the issue itself.

summary.description: One line summarising the change, without a type prefix; Foundry adds it.

changes.description: What the change does, one short line each, in terms of behaviour rather than a list of types, methods or enum values.

verification.description: What you ran to verify the change and its result, one short line each, such as a test command and how many tests passed.

cause.description: Only for a run that fixes something, such as failing checks, review feedback or a conflict: what failed and why, in one or two sentences.

attention.description: Only what a reviewer must check before merging, such as something you could not verify or a known gap. Leave it out when there is nothing.

notes.description: Implementation details a reviewer may want, such as a migration or a design choice, in Markdown. Foundry shows them collapsed.
